title: Highlights of Kazakhstan - Flight Inclusive Deal
highlights: Embark on a journey along the ancient Silk Road in Kazakhstan, where age-old traditions meet innovation.
Explore Central Asia's largest ski resort, Shymbulak, and marvel at the Zenkov Cathedral, the world's second-tallest wooden church.
Experience the scenic cable car ride to Kok Tobe, the highest point of Almaty and admire the Beatles Monument: a homage to the Fab Four's timeless influence on music.
Unveil the authentic beauty of Kazakhstan from lush green valleys, to vast deserts and turquoise lakes.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival at Almaty | Day at leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Almaty, the City of Thousand Colours! Upon arrival at Almaty Airport, you will be transferred to the hotel for check-in. Spend the day exploring the city independently. Take a stroll through Mahatma Gandhi Park or shop around Arbat Street. Experience the local culture by sampling cuisines like Beshbarmak and admiring stunning Soviet-era architectural pieces such as the Kazakh State Circus and the Palace of the Republic. After a day of exploration, return to your hotel for the night.

items.title: Flight - Indira Gandhi International Airport to Almaty International Airport

days.title: Almaty City Tour
days.desc: This day is about exploring Almaty. Begin your day with a visit to the Panfilov Park or the Park of 28 Panfilov Guardsmen, dedicated to the 28 soldiers who bravely fought in World War II. Walk around the park and visit the Ascension Cathedral, world's second tallest wooden church and an architectural marvel built entirely from wood.  In the evening, head to Republic Square to capture the stunning sunset views and admire the Independence Monument. Get transferred back to the hotel for the night.

items.title: Almaty City Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Day trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink and Shymbulak Ski Resort
days.desc: Begin your journey to Medeu, an outdoor speed skating rink. Enjoy skiing at one of the world's largest alpine skating rinks before taking scenic cable car ride to the Shymbulak Ski Resort, located at an elevation of roughly 2,200 metres above sea level. Enjoy the stunning views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. After a day of skiing or snowboarding, relax at one of the resort's cozy cafes while enjoying local cuisine and hot beverages. Later, get transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort on a Private basis

days.title: Visit Green Bazaar & Rahat Chocolate Factory | Visit to Kok Tobe Park
days.desc: Today, make your way to Green Bazaar, a vibrant marketplace. It’s an ideal spot to shop for local delights, traditional Kazakh crafts, and souvenirs. Engage with locals as you explore the city's vibrant culture. Proceed to Rahat Chocolate Factory to witness the art of chocolate-making. Lastly, take a picturesque cable car ride to KokTobe Park. Embrace the spectacular views of the city and the surroundings, and indulge in recreational activities offered by the park. Later, get back to the hotel.
